title.narrative: 23M-MYWO - Clean Energy Drinking Water Solutions in Kenya

description.narrative: The project objective is to mature the commercial sales and distribution model of the clean energy SaWa solutions using solar purification technology, thereby creating income for women and improving livelihoods of poor households in Kenya, while reducing risks of water borne diseases and GHG emissions from avoiding the need for firewood or charcoal for boiling water. Through the structures of MYWO, 125 women will be targeted as sales agents, distributing 30,000 Sawas and thereby improving access to clean and safe drinking water for approx. 15,000 households. The scaling potential is significant as the SaWa is one of the world's most affordable clean energy drinking water purification solutions, and by partnering with Africa’s largest women organisation, MYWO, with its 4 million members. The project supports Kenya Vision 2030, and relevant national water plans, policies and strategies.
